source: 634 Fresh Off The Boat
target: 634 Recens ex nave

source: In the well-lit lobby of Hotel Orella, aboveground, Lugano effortlessly balanced Ludwig, munching on a burrito, in one hand and clutched his suitcase in the other.
target: In atrio bene illustrato Hotel Orella, super terram, Lugano Ludwig facile temperabat, dum burrito devorabat, una manu tenens alteramque manu sarcinam suam stringebat.

source: His eyes darted around uneasily.
target: Oculi eius anxie circumvolitabant.

source: From his adventurous beginnings to trailing Lumian south, he’d never lodged in a place proudly declaring itself a “hotel” instead of a “motel.”
target: Ex initiis suis audacibus ad sectam Lumiani meridianam, numquam in loco manserat qui se cum superbia “hotel” potius quam “motel” appellaret.

source: He’d only encountered Trier’s renowned Grand Champs-Élysée in newspapers and magazines, learning that its construction cost a whopping 21 million verl d’or.
target: Trieri celeberrimum Grand Champs-Élysée tantum in diurnis et commentariis occurrerat, discens eius constructionem constare 21 miliones “verl d’or.”

source: With 800 rooms and 65 functional halls, even the most basic accommodations demanded 12 verl d’or per day in the off-season.
target: Cum 800 conclavibus et 65 aulae utilibus, etiam simplicissima hospitia poscebant 12 “verl d’or” per diem in tempore extra.

source: A stark contrast to Lugano’s usual frugal 3.5 verl d’or weekly motel stays.
target: Contrarium ac solita modica sustentatione Lugani, qui in “motel” hebdomadali 3.5 “verl d’or” imponebat.

source: The bustling metropolis of Trier had left an indelible mark on Lugano, urging him to rise above and recommend himself to Lumian.
target: Trier urbs fervens indelibile vestigium in Lugano reliquit, eum hortans ut surgeret ac se Lumiano commendaret.

source: Accumulating wealth, obtaining potion ingredients, and advancing to Doctor became his priorities.
target: Divitias colligere, potionis ingredientes obtinere, et ad gradum Doctoris progredi facta sunt eius principale negotia.

source: He aspired to join the ranks of high society!
target: Societatem nobilitatis se iungere optabat!

source: Only when he became a Doctor did he grasp the vastness of the Beyonder world.
target: Modo, cum Doctor factus esset, immensitatem orbis Beyonder comprehendit.

source: He had barely scratched its surface.
target: Vix superficiem eius attingerat.

source: The male receptionist, sporting curly black hair, dark brown skin, and a keen countenance, addressed Lugano in fluent Intisian.
target: Recepciō virīlis, capillis atrīs crispīs, cute fusca et vultū acūtō ornātus, Lugānō in lingua Intisiānā fluente allocūtus est.

source: “Would you prefer a suite or a standard room? Are you inclined towards a coffin bed or a conventional one?”
target: “Velisne conclāve aut cubiculum ordinārium? An adsuescitur lectō, ut lectus sarcophāgīcum, vel audesne eligere modum tritum?”

source: Lugano glanced at his employer.
target: Lugānō ad dominum suum intuebātur.

source: Lumian toyed with a caramel-colored East Balam cigarette wrapped in roasted tobacco leaves, bringing it to his nose for a gentle sniff.
target: Lumian lusum habuit cum cigaaretā East Balam, colore caramellico, involutā in foliīs tabācī tostī, quam ad nāsum leviter attulit odorandum.

source: He savored the blend of tobacco leaves, internal spices, and assorted herbs.
target: Saporem mixtiōnis foliorum tabācī, specierum internārum, et herbarum variārum degustāvit.

source: The aroma was mildly invigorating and redolent, tempting one to inhale deeply.
target: Odor leniter vigebat et fragrābat, simulans ad altum inspirandum.

source: “A suite. Standard, and closer to ground level.”
target: “Conclāve. Ordinārium, et propius ad terram.”

source: Lumian had sampled rental coffins for transportation and had no plans to continue sleeping in them.
target: Lumian sarcophāga locandī experītus erat et nullo consiliō de illīs dormitandō permanēre decreverat.

source: It wasn’t a traumatic experience, but it did alter his perception of his surroundings.
target: Non fuit experientia trauminōsa, sed tamen perceptionem circa eum mutavit.

source: In case of an attack, it could impede his initial response.
target: In casū impetuōrum, responsum primum eius impedīre poterat.

source: Lugano sighed in relief upon hearing Lumian’s decision and conveyed the employer’s request to the male receptionist.
target: Lugānō ex solātiōne suspirāvit, audītō Lumiani consiliō, et petitiōnem dominī sui receptōrī virīlī trādidit.

source: “8 verl d’or a day. Three days’ payment in advance,” the native male receptionist stated the price.
target: “8 ‘verl d’or’ per diem. Solūtiō trīum diērum praeviā,” inquit receptōr indigenus de pretīō.

source: After Lugano completed the payment, the receptionist, with a nod to his colleagues, said obsequiously, “I’ll escort you down.”
target: Postquam Lugānō solutionem confēcit, receptōr, capite ad collegās subnōtā, obsequius inquit, “Te comitābor deorsum.”

source: Three mechanical elevators stood at the back of the hall.
target: Trēs elevātorēs mechanicī in parte postica āulae steterunt.

source: Lumian and his group entered the middle door, pulling the brass handle to B3.
target: Lumian et turma eius ianuam mediam intrāvērunt, manubrium aereum ad B3 trahentēs.

source: Chains tightened, gears clamped, and various metal parts started to operate with resonating sounds.
target: Catenae contrāxitēs sunt, rotae constitūtæ, et variae partes metallī cum sonīs resonantibus in mōtiōnem coepērunt.

source: In the distance, it resembled the roar of a boiler, and white steam billowed out.
target: In longinquō, fremitus caldārī imitābatur, et vapor albus effulgebat.

source: As the mechanical elevator descended, the native receptionist glanced at Ludwig and smiled at Lumian.
target: Dum elevātorem mechanicum deorsum descendēbat, receptōr indigenus Ludgigi spectāvit et Lumianō subrīdens aspexit.

source: “Settling down in Port Pylos, are you?
target: “Incolitur in Port Pylos, esne?

source: “If you need info on local grammar schools and rentals in different communities, feel free to approach me.”
target: Si desiderās informationem de schōlīs grammaticīs locālibus et de locātiōnibus in variīs communitātibus, libere ad mē accēde.

source: In his view, anyone bringing a seven- or eight-year-old child to the Southern Continent was likely moving, not merely traveling.
target: Eius iudiciō, quis puerum septem vel octo annōrum ad Continentem Meridionālem adfert, verisimiliter migrābat, non tantum iter faciens.

source: After all, the child was too young for perilous long-distance journeys.
target: Nam puer nimis iuvenis erat ad itinerēs periculōs longinquōs.

source: Moving meant finding a house—renting or buying—and choosing a good school. These were all opportunities to make money!
target: Migrātiō quidem significābat domum inveniendam—vel locandam vel emendam—et schōlam bonam eligendam; haec omnia erant occasōnes lucrandi!

source: At the mention of “school,” Ludwig, munching on a roasted corn cob, suddenly stopped chewing, as if the food had lost its fragrance.
target: Ad mentionem “scholae,” Ludwig, maizum tostum edendō, subito masticāre dēsiēit, quasi cibus suus odōrem amīssisset.

source: Lumian wasn’t oblivious to the native receptionist’s thoughts but didn’t mind. Instead, he admired the man’s shrewdness.
target: Lumian cogitātiōnibus receptōris indigenī ignorare nōn potuit, sed minūs curāvit; immo callidātem eius admirābat.

source: He grinned and remarked, “I’ll take a look first. We haven’t confirmed if we would stay in Port Pylos.”
target: Subrīdens dīxit, “Primum incipiam aspicere. Nondum constitūtum est an in Port Pylos maneāmus.”

source: At that moment, the mechanical elevator halted at B3.
target: Illo momento, elevātorem mechanicum in B3 sistit.

source: Entering the room on the right, with a stone fence on one side and the cold valley aisle on the other, Lumian addressed the native receptionist, “Do you know Tizamo Town?”
target: Intrans in conclāve dextro, cum saepē lapidēā ad ūnum latus et corridorī frigidi in vallē ad alterum, Lumian ad receptōrem indigenum locūtus est, “Novistine oppidum Tizamo?”

source: The native receptionist, aiding Lugano with the suitcase, slightly bent and led the way.
target: Recepciō indigenus, Lugānō cum sarcinā adiuvāns, leviter inclinātus viam duxit.

source: "I do. Many gentlemen head to Tizamo on weekends for forest hunting."
target: "Scio. Multi viri in finibus hebdomādum ad Tizamo properant ad silvestrem venandam."

source: "There are secret temples and mausoleums left behind by former nobles in the forest. If you want to have fun, don’t venture too deep. The primitive tribes there are barbaric and savage."
target: "In silvā templa arcāna et mausolea ā pristīnīs nōbilibus relicta sunt. Si vis delectātiōnem, noli nimis alte ingredī. Tribus ibi primitīvī sunt—barbaricāe et ferocēs."

source: Lumian nodded, not probing further. Upon reaching Suite 7 and entering the living room, he casually tossed a verl d’or silver coin to the native receptionist.
target: Lumian annuīt, non ulterius inquisēns; ad Conclāve 7 pervenīens et in camērā convivīī intrāns, leviter nummum argenteum “verl d’or” receptōrī indigenō mīsit.

source: “What’s your name?”
target: "Quid est nōmen tuum?"

source: The receptionist, pleasantly surprised, responded, “You can call me Ron.”
target: Recepciō, laetā mirātus, respondit, "Mē Ron vocāre potēs."

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian subrīdens exsolvit.

source: “I might have to trouble you often in the future. For example, what’s the name of the nearest and better bars? Where is it?”
target: "Forsitan te saepe in futurum molestābō. Exempli causā, quid nōmen est tabernārum proximārum et melīorum? Ubi illa sita est?"

source: Ron touched the silver coin and smiled.
target: Ron nummum argenteum tetigit et subrīdens risit.

source: “It’s my honor to assist you.
target: Meum honōrem est tē adiuvāre.

source: “Head to the Man-Eating Flower Bar. Intisian is used for communication there. It’s on the street behind our hotel.”
target: Dirige ad Tabernam “Man-Eating Flower.” Lingua Intisianā ibi ad communicātiōnem adhibētur. Ea in plateā post hotel nostrum sita est.

source: Lumian instructed Lugano and left the room with Ron, waiting for one of the mechanical elevators.
target: Lumian Lugānō instrūxit et cum Ron conclāvem reliquit, exspectāns unum ex elevātoribus mechanicīs.

source: Inside, a man with a deathly pale face and vacant eyes stood.
target: Intus, vir vultū mortiferō pallidō et oculīs vacuīs stabat.

source: The man’s face was deathly pale, and his eyes were vacant. He wore a wrinkled shirt and pants.
target: Vultus viri mortiferō pallidus erat, et oculī eius vacuī erant. Induebat camisiam rugosam et brācās.

source: Lumian glanced at him without a word.
target: Lumian eum sine verbō intuebātur.

source: Amidst the tightening of the chain and the relatively stable elevation, the mechanical lift returned to the ground.
target: Inter contractionem catenae et elevātiōnem relativē stābilī, elevātorem mechanicum ad terram rediit.

source: Once the vacant-eyed man exited the lift and distanced himself from them, Ron leaned closer to Lumian and whispered, “I wanted to remind you to pretend not to see that customer.”
target: Cum vir oculīs vacuīs elevatorem reliqueret et a eīs se distanseret, Ron ad Lumian propius inclinātus susurravit, "Te admonēre voluī ut simulās illum emptōrem non vidēre."

source: “Who is he?” Lumian asked casually.
target: "Quis est illē?" inquit Lumian leviter.

source: Ron glanced around and lowered his voice.
target: Ron circumspēciebat et vocem demīsit.

source: “He resides in a suite at B18, a servant of Mr. Iveljsta.
target: "Illē habitat in conclāve B18, servus Domini Iveljsta,

source: “That gentleman’s servants don’t seem normal.”
target: et servi illius dominī nōn videntur esse ordinārī."

source: Of course, it’s not normal. They are walking corpses… Lumian criticized.
target: Certe, nōn est normale. Ambulant cadāvera… Lumian increpāvit.

source: He had already observed the servant and realized his fate was dark and that of a deceased.
target: Servum iam observāverat et intellexerat fatum eius esse obscūrum et simile mortuōrum.

source: Lumian wasn’t surprised to encounter such a situation in a country that once worshipped Death.
target: Lumian nōn mirātus est talem condicionem in terra, quae olim Mortem collaudābat, occurrere.

source: Having already seen the Blood Emperor’s afterimage, encountering a zombie was hardly shocking.
target: Iam imaginem Imperatoris Sanguinis visō, occurrere zombi vix stupefactum erat.

source: In the sweltering evening, Lumian bypassed the artificial deep valley where Hotel Orella stood and entered a street with an unpronounceable name.
target: In vespere suffocantī, Lumian vallēm profundam artificiālem, ubi Hotel Orella stabat, praetereīit et in plateam cum nomine inpronunciabili ingressus est.

source: He spotted a bar adorned with an exaggerated Man-Eating Flower.
target: Animādvertit tabernam ornatam flōre “Man-Eating Flower” exaggeratō.

source: Donning a golden straw hat, he lit the East Balam cigarette purchased from the hotel lobby and placed it between his lips.
target: Pileo stramineō aureō indūtus, accendit cigaaretam East Balam, ex atriō hotel acquisitā, et inter labra posuit.

source: Cough, cough, cough!
target: Tüssis, tüssis, tüssis!

source: Lumian quickly coughed, emitting white smoke from his nose.
target: Lumian celeriter tussivit, fumum album e nāsō efferēns.

source: His intention was to showcase his experience as an experienced adventurer by smoking East Balam cigarettes, but he hadn’t anticipated their potency.
target: Propositum eius erat experientiā suā enarrantem ūtī, fumigandō cigaaretās East Balam, sed illōrum potentiam nōn praevidit.

source: As someone who rarely smoked, he found it unbearable.
target: Quia raro fumābat, id intolerābile invenit.

source: In Cordu, various cheap alcohols abounded, but cigarettes were scarce.
target: In Cordū, varia alcoholia vilia abundābant, sed cigaaretās raro inveniebantur.

source: Lumian had only witnessed Pons Bénet, Louis Lund, and a few others indulging in smoking.
target: Lumian tantum Pons Bénet, Louis Lund, et paucos alios fumantēs conspectus habuerat.

source: After extinguishing the East Balam cigarette and tossing it into the trash can, Lumian entered the bar and skillfully approached the counter.
target: Postquam cigaaretam East Balam exstinxit eamque in receptāculum abjēcit, Lumian in tabernam intrāvit et peritē ad tabulam accessit.

source: He pulled up a barstool and settled in.
target: Tabernariam scamnum attulit et consedit.

source: Sensing the lingering smoke in his mouth, he opted for something milder.
target: Fumosum in ore residuum sentiens, aliquid mite eligere constituit.

source: He tapped the counter and spoke in Intisian, “A glass of kilju, the regular kind.”
target: Tabulam pulsavit et in lingua Intisiānā locūtus est, "Calicem kilju, generis ordināriī."

source: “Ten licks,” replied the bartender, a local man in a white shirt and black vest, his Intisian tinged with a distinct accent.
target: "Decem labatōnēs," respondit caupo, vir localis in albā camisiā et nigro vestimēntō, cuius sermo Intisiānus singularī accentū distinctus erat.

source: Lumian settled the bill and awaited the bartender’s pour.
target: Lumian ratiōnem solvit et effūsiōnem cauponis exspectavit.

source: He discreetly surveyed the area, noticing nobody paying him any heed except for a dozen wanted posters adorning the bar’s wall.
target: Areae discreē inspexit, animādvertēns nemēn eum attendere, nisi duodecim posterēs desiderātōs in pariete tabernae.

source: Thoughtfully accepting the amber-colored kilju, he adjusted his golden straw hat and addressed the bartender with a smile, “Do you know who I am?”
target: Cautē kilju ambra colore accipiēns, pileum stramineum aureum aptavit et caupo, subrīdēns, allocūtus est, "Novistine quīs sim?"

source: The bartender glanced at him and smiled back.
target: Caupo eum intuebātur et subrīdens reddidit.

source: “Every now and then, a self-proclaimed renowned adventurer poses that question, but I’m sorry, I don’t know you.”
target: "Interdum, clarus viatōr se ipse praedicēns hanc quaestiōnem proponit, sed me paenitet, tē nōn novi."

source: From the looks of it, the adventurer Louis Berry’s exploits in hunting the Demon Warlock are primarily known in the Fog Sea.
target: Ex aspectū vidētur rēs gestae adventorīs Louis Berry in venātiōne Daemōnis Warlock praesertim notae esse in Mārē Nebulōso.

source: My rising fame was tied to activities within the Church of Earth Mother’s sphere of influence.
target: Mea fama crescente conexa erat actionibus intra sphaeram influentiāris Ecclesiae Matris Terrae.

source: Louis Berry’s reputation waned upon entering the Berserk Sea, and few in West Balam are familiar with him…
target: Fama Louis Berry deminūtā est cum in Mārē Berserk intrāret, et paucī in West Balam eum cognoscunt…

source: If Hisoka isn’t stationed at the docks every day, he likely doesn’t know about my arrival in Port Pylos…
target: Si Hisoka nōn quotidie in molibus praesidēt, verisimiliter de adventū meō in Port Pylos nōn noviāt.

source: Lumian refrained from erupting in rage at the bartender’s words.
target: Lumian fūrōrum ne exārsēret verba cauponis cohibuit.

source: He sipped his kilju, contemplating the situation.
target: Kilju sorbuit, rem contemplāns.

source: Noticing Lumian’s silence, the bartender casually smiled and remarked, “You just arrived in the Southern Continent, right?”
target: Lumian silentium animādvertēns, caupo leviter subrīdēns dīxit, "Modo in Continentem Meridionālem pervenīst, nōnne?"

source: “Yes, I left the Berserk Sea this morning.”
target: "Immo, hoc mane Mārē Berserk reliquī."

source: Lumian seamlessly assumed the role of a regular at Ol’ Tavern, recounting his story with a smile.
target: Lumian munus regularis apud "Ol’ Tavern" facile assumpsit, fābulam suam subrīdēns narrāns.

source: “Encountered a ghost ship in the Berserk Sea, danced with dried corpses under the moon, and repelled a Demon’s attack. Praise the Mother of All Things. You might never understand how magical and dangerous the Berserk Sea is…”
target: "Navem phantasmaticam in Mārē Berserk convenī, cum cadāveribus exaridis sub lūnā saltāvī et impetum Daemōnis repulī. Laudetur Mater Omnium Rerum. Forsit numquam intellegēs quanta mōs et perīculum Mārē Berserk sit…"

source: The bartender wiped the glass’s inner wall and interrupted Lumian.
target: Caupo parietem interiorem vitrei evellit et Lumian interpellāvit.

source: “I know. After all, that’s where Death disappeared.”
target: "Scīō. Nam ibi Mors evanuit."

source: “Where Death disappeared?” Lumian asked in surprise.
target: "Ubi Mors evanuit?" inquirīvit Lumian mirātus.

source: While he had speculated about the dangers of the Berserk Sea and abnormal weather being linked to a deity’s demise, he hadn’t expected such an easy answer.
target: Cum de perīculīs Māris Berserk et tempestate insolitā, quae ad deī interitūs pertinēbant, speculāret, talem responsum facile nōn praevidit.

source: The bartender regarded Lumian with an expression that implied, “You’re actually a rookie.”
target: Caupo Lumian aspiciens vultū indicantī, "Revera es novitius," inquit.

source: “Have you never heard of the legend of treasures at sea?
target: "Numquam audīvistine de legenda thesaurōrum in māre?

source: “At the top is Death’s Key. It’s said that at the end of the Fourth Epoch, Death, who had lost the Pale-White War, stirred violent waves to obstruct the returning enemy to Balam, creating insurmountable obstacles that severed the Northern and Southern Continents. However, He ultimately didn’t return to His throne and vanished. Only those with the special key can find Him, discover the treasures He left behind, and gain His boon.”
target: "Ad summum est Clāvis Mortis. Dicitur quod ad finem Quartae Aetātis, Mors, quī Palae-Album Bellum perdidit, undās feroces excitāvit ut hostem rediens ad Balam obstāret, creando obstacula insuperābilia quæ Continēntēs Septentrionālēs et Meridionālēs dividerent. Tamen, nōn ad thronum Suum rediit et evanuit. Solī, quī clavem peculīārem possīdunt, Eum invenīr(e), thesaurōs quī reliquit detegere, et beneficium Suum adipisci possunt."

source: The bartender’s tone was complicated.
target: Tonus cauponis complicātus erat.

source: Lumian fell silent.
target: Lumian silentium cepit.

source: He had embarked on the sea seeking revenge and held little interest in treasure legends. He hadn’t anticipated missing such crucial information.
target: In māre profectus erat ultionem petēns et de legendīs thesaurōrum parum curābat. Tale informationis momentum nōn praevidit.

source: Just then, the heavy wooden door of the bar creaked open.
target: Tum, iānuā lignea gravis tabernae strīdorem edidit, aperta.

source: The once-noisy bar hushed in an instant.
target: Taberna, olim strepitōsa, statim silentium cepit.

source: Sensing the shift in atmosphere, Lumian turned his body, fixing his gaze upon the door.
target: Mutātiōnem atmosphaerae sentiens, Lumian se convertit et oculōs in iānuam fīxos tenuit.
